_metadata.description: Applicability rules for all 59 Level 2 workflows in the Evercam ROI system. Defines which workflows are relevant to a given project based on category, scale, geography, features, and pain points. Applicability scores are computed by the agent at runtime using the formula defined in roi-workflow-applicability.md. This file provides the raw signals per workflow.
_metadata.status: provisional — initial estimates based on workflow characteristics, not yet validated by domain experts
_metadata.scoring_note: Applicability scores are computed by the agent at runtime using the formula defined in roi-workflow-applicability.md. This file provides the raw signals per workflow.

category_defaults._note: Default category_applicability by parent_category. Individual workflows override these where needed. Scores: 0 = never relevant, 0.25 = rarely, 0.5 = sometimes, 0.75 = usually, 1.0 = always relevant.
